run_pass_export: run the _ExportPassBaseDeprecatedDoNotUse pass on a torch fx GraphModule to transform the exported graph
call_operator_dispatch: call operator dispatch to execute a torch op through the export interpreter with proxy values
call_cond_branch: call conditional branch handling to interpret if/else higher-order ops in the exported graph
call_map_iteration: call map iteration handling to interpret torch.ops.higher_order.map_impl operations
call_submodule_process: call submodule processing to recursively trace and interpret nested graph modules
